name: Sparkline
description: A tiny inline trend chart in line, area, or bar form with an accessible summary.

anatomy.description: A line, filled area, or one bar per data point, drawn in the primary color and scaled to the data's min/max range.
role="img" carrying the required aria-label that summarizes the trend.
Visually hidden text stating the min, max, and last values.

dos: Write an aria-label that states the takeaway, like "Sign-ups trending up".
Use the bar variant for discrete counts such as deploys per day.
Pair with a Stat when the exact current figure matters.
donts: Don't plot multiple series in one sparkline; use LineChart instead.
Don't use it where users need exact values or axes; it is a glanceable trend only.

examples.title: Trends at a glance
examples.description: role="img" carries the label; a visually hidden min, max, and last summary backs it up.

examples.title: Bars and falling trends
examples.description: The bar variant suits discrete daily counts; the area variant reads well for a falling trend.

guidance.useWhen: A compact trend belongs inline next to a metric, in a table cell, or inside a Stat.
guidance.avoidWhen: Users need exact values, axes, or several series; use LineChart or BarChart.
guidance.behavior: Values scale to the data's min/max range; a flat series centers the line and a single value renders a dot.
guidance.responsive: Fixed pixel width and height by design; size it to the slot it accompanies.

notes: The aria-label is required and the SVG renders role="img", so the trend is announced as a labelled image.
A visually hidden summary states the min, max, and last values for screen-reader users.

props.description: Accessible description of the trend, applied as aria-label.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Chart style: line, filled area, or bars.
props.name: variant
